entities.name: Lounge Terminal

properties.address: 5th Floor, Caculo Mall St Inez Rd, Caculo Enclave, Santa Inez Panaji, Goa 403001 India
properties.description: Fifth-floor lounge-bar in Caculo Mall offering Goan small plates, craft beers, cocktails, outdoor seating and late-night vegetarian and vegan options.
properties.short_description: Fifth-floor lounge-bar in Caculo Mall offering Goan small plates, craft beers, cocktails, outdoor seating and late-night vegetarian and vegan options.
properties.cuisine_description: Lounge Terminal specializes in Goan small plates and contemporary snacks, offering a menu that includes Rawa Fried Prawns and late-night biryani. The venue provides extensive beverage options ranging from craft beers and wine to a variety of cocktails and hard spirits, with unique features like a liquor bank vault service. Dietary needs are accommodated with dedicated vegetarian and vegan meal options.
properties.overall_description: Lounge Terminal is a stylish, multi-functional lounge and dining destination situated in the heart of Panaji. With its mix of indoor comfort and outdoor seating, it serves as a popular hub for everything from casual afternoon drinks to high-energy late-night social gatherings. Known for its distinct liquor bank vault service and craft beer selection, it offers a sophisticated yet relaxed experience for groups and solo visitors alike. The venue is a premier choice for those looking to enjoy local snacks and drinks while watching sports or celebrating special occasions in an upscale environment.
properties.service_description: Lounge Terminal offers a relaxed atmosphere suitable for various occasions, including social gatherings, intimate ceremonies, and casual drinks with friends. The venue provides dine-in service with comfortable indoor and outdoor seating, along with takeout options. It is well-regarded for its event hosting capabilities, catering to private parties and celebrations in an elegant setting.
properties.ambience_description: The atmosphere is contemporary and chic, characterized by comfortable lounge seating, mood lighting, and soothing background music. It is designed to be an inviting, upscale space for both social gatherings and solo relaxation.
properties.amenities_description: The lounge offers premium amenities including a dedicated smoking room, large screens for viewing sports, and a secure liquor storage service for frequent patrons. Guests can enjoy both indoor air-conditioned comfort and open-air seating.
properties.unique_selling_points: The venue features a unique liquor vault that allows patrons to purchase bottles at a value and store them for future visits. It is widely recognized for combining a high-end, comfortable lounge aesthetic with accessible late-night snack options.
properties.neighborhood_description: Situated in the heart of the city within a major shopping enclave, the area is well-connected and easily accessible for locals and visitors alike.
properties.physical_setting_description: Located on the fifth floor of a city shopping mall, the space features both an air-conditioned interior and an outdoor seating area. It provides a elevated perspective of the surrounding urban area.
properties.customer_demographics_description: The restaurant attracts a social crowd, primarily consisting of locals, young professionals, and groups of friends looking for a place to unwind. It is a popular destination for solo diners and individuals celebrating milestones or attending sports matches, appealing to those who appreciate a vibrant yet relaxing lounge environment.

properties.short_description: Contemporary hotel with modern rooms, rooftop pool, spa, and international dining, centrally located in Panaji near Miramar Beach.

While the property is situated in a busy urban area, its standout feature is the exceptionally high standard of personalized service and warm hospitality provided by its staff. Guests can enjoy modern, well-appointed rooms, a relaxing rooftop pool, and highly-rated dining options that celebrate both international and authentic local cuisines.
properties.ambience_description: The atmosphere is defined by a polished and hospitable professional environment where attentive staff prioritize guest comfort and a seamless experience.
properties.amenities_description: Vivanta Goa, Panaji is a contemporary, centrally located hotel offering modern guest rooms and international dining options. The property features a rooftop swimming pool, a full-service spa, a fitness center, and business facilities. Guests benefit from 24-hour front desk service, concierge assistance, laundry services, and airport shuttle arrangements. properties.unique_selling_points: The property is renowned for its exceptional, high-touch hospitality and personalized service that consistently exceeds guest expectations. It also features a popular rooftop pool and highly regarded international and local dining options.
properties.neighborhood_description: The surrounding area is a bustling, central urban neighborhood that serves as the heart of the city, providing convenient access to local landmarks and business districts.
properties.physical_setting_description: Situated in the heart of Panaji, the property is located in an urban setting near the city's key commercial and cultural venues. While it lacks panoramic vistas, it offers easy access to major local attractions and professional hubs.

properties.short_description: Intimate small-plates cocktail bar in central Panaji offering global small plates, seafood specialties and craft cocktails with private dining.
properties.cuisine_description: Petisco is a sophisticated gastropub and cocktail bar serving innovative fusion cuisine that blends traditional Goan flavors with European techniques. The menu focuses on small plates, featuring expertly prepared seafood, creative meat dishes, and unique desserts. Beverage offerings include a highly-regarded selection of craft cocktails and spirits. The restaurant caters to vegetarians and offers an intimate fine dining experience in a cozy, multi-level atmosphere.
properties.overall_description: A sophisticated culinary landmark in the heart of the city, this establishment is renowned for its innovative small-plates concept that seamlessly blends local Goan ingredients with classic European techniques. Spread across three levels, including a unique underground space for live music, it offers a vibrant yet intimate atmosphere perfect for date nights and special social gatherings. The menu is a masterclass in flavor and presentation, complemented by an exceptional array of handcrafted signature cocktails. With its focus on high-quality, creatively prepared dishes and attentive service, it has become a must-visit destination for those seeking an elevated and memorable dining experience.
properties.service_description: The restaurant provides an upscale dining service with a strong emphasis on personalized attention and hospitality. They offer indoor and outdoor seating across multiple levels, hosting live music performances and private dining events. The establishment is well-suited for special occasions, date nights, and socializing over expertly crafted cocktails and small plates.
properties.ambience_description: The atmosphere is intimate and sophisticated, blending cozy, stylish interiors with an artistic flair that feels both relaxing for afternoon visits and lively during evening music sets.
properties.amenities_description: The venue offers a multi-level dining experience with outdoor seating, a private dining room for exclusive gatherings, and a full bar featuring extensive craft cocktail and wine selections.
properties.unique_selling_points: The establishment pioneered the small-plates concept in the region, focusing on a unique fusion of Goan flavors and European techniques presented with high culinary artistry.
properties.neighborhood_description: The surrounding area is a historic and walkable part of the city, conveniently located opposite a local garden, anchoring the restaurant within a lively yet intimate urban setting.
properties.physical_setting_description: Situated in the heart of the city, this cozy venue is spread across multiple levels, including a distinct underground space that hosts live music.
properties.customer_demographics_description: Petisco attracts a discerning crowd of foodies, cocktail enthusiasts, and local professionals who appreciate fine dining and creative culinary fusion. It is a popular destination for couples on dates, tourists exploring the local scene, and groups of friends seeking a vibrant, high-quality dining and social experience.

entities.name: Miri

properties.address: FRJ8+WCG, Hotel Sunheads, St. Mary's Colony lane no 3, Nalanda Colony, Miramar Panaji, Goa 403001 India
properties.description: Contemporary Miramar fusion restaurant and steakhouse serving global small plates, steaks, cocktails, halal and vegetarian options with late‑night dining and coffee.
properties.short_description: Contemporary Miramar fusion restaurant and steakhouse serving global small plates, steaks, cocktails, halal and vegetarian options with late‑night dining and coffee.
properties.cuisine_description: Miri offers a contemporary global fusion dining experience in Miramar, Panjim, featuring an innovative menu that blends diverse culinary traditions. The restaurant is particularly celebrated for its steaks, small plates, and unique fusion creations that incorporate local Goan flavors using techniques like molecular gastronomy. The menu includes diverse options ranging from Thai curries and Burmese Khow Suey to classic American-style burgers and steaks, with dedicated vegetarian, vegan, and halal-friendly dishes available. Signature items include the 'Goa' starter, a variety of expertly prepared steaks, and innovative desserts like the tender coconut serradura, all complemented by a robust bar program featuring cocktails and specialty mocktails.
properties.overall_description: This contemporary fusion destination in Miramar, Panjim, creates a memorable dining experience by blending global influences with local Goan flavors. Renowned for its exceptional steaks and creative small plates, the restaurant offers an intimate and cozy environment that is popular with both locals and visitors. With a menu that features everything from hearty breakfast platters to late-night bites, the establishment focuses on high-quality presentation and innovative culinary techniques. The presence of engaging events like quiz nights and live music further complements the attentive service provided by the staff.
properties.service_description: Miri provides a cozy and inviting environment suitable for a range of dining occasions from casual breakfasts and quick bites to celebratory dinners and private outings. Guests can enjoy a full-service dine-in experience, with additional convenience options including takeout and delivery. The restaurant frequently hosts engaging social events like quiz nights and features live music to enhance the atmosphere, making it a popular destination for both local residents and tourists in the Miramar area.
properties.ambience_description: The space is defined by a cozy and inviting atmosphere, where simplistic decor allows the focus to remain squarely on the food. Guests often enjoy a pleasant environment enhanced by background live music.
properties.amenities_description: The venue features a full bar offering curated cocktails and mocktails, with facilities for hosting events such as quiz nights. Service options include dine-in, takeaway, and delivery to accommodate varying guest needs.
properties.unique_selling_points: The menu excels in inventive global fusion, highlighted by the signature 'Goa' dish, which masterfully captures traditional regional flavors in a single molecular bite. It is widely recognized as a premier destination for high-quality steaks in the local area.
properties.neighborhood_description: Situated in the tranquil St. Mary's Colony, the area provides a calm, low-key residential atmosphere that feels removed from the bustle of the city center.
properties.physical_setting_description: Tucked away in a quiet residential lane in Miramar, Panjim, this restaurant is part of a hotel property. Its location offers a peaceful escape from the nearby main road while remaining centrally accessible within the city.
properties.customer_demographics_description: The restaurant serves a diverse clientele that includes local residents of Goa, tourists exploring the Miramar area, and hotel guests. It is particularly popular with foodies and diners seeking innovative, high-quality fusion cuisine in a cozy, welcoming setting. The customer base spans from young adults and professionals looking for a trendy date spot or social venue to families and groups of friends gathering for shared meals.

entities.name: For The Record - Vinyl Bar

properties.address: Jukebox, H no 49, Next to Audiophile Goa nr. मारूती मंदिर, Fontainhas (quarter), Mala Panaji, Goa 403001 India
properties.description: Vinyl-focused bar and restaurant in Fontainhas offering cocktails, wines, beer and bar dining amid retro record-themed ambiance.
properties.short_description: Vinyl-focused bar and restaurant in Fontainhas offering cocktails, wines, beer and bar dining amid retro record-themed ambiance.
properties.cuisine_description: For The Record - Vinyl Bar serves an innovative menu blending Italian classics like Neapolitan-style sourdough pizzas with creative fusion dishes such as Turkish pide and locally-inspired Goan appetizers. The food program focuses on fermented ingredients and seasonal, locally-sourced produce. Beverage offerings highlight a sophisticated cocktail program, featuring specialty drinks made with local Feni, alongside a selection of craft beers and wines, all curated to pair with their unique culinary offerings.
properties.overall_description: This unique establishment in the heart of Fontainhas serves as a premier destination for audiophiles and cocktail enthusiasts, combining a high-fidelity vinyl listening experience with innovative, locally-inspired mixology. The menu is celebrated for its artisanal sourdough pizzas, fermented snacks, and signature feni-based drinks served in a rustic, retro-cozy environment. Whether sitting in the air-conditioned indoor bar or the quiet outdoor courtyard, guests are treated to a curated soundscape that emphasizes jazz, blues, and classic records. It is a one-of-a-kind haven for those seeking a relaxed, authentic, and sensory-driven evening in Goa.
properties.service_description: For The Record - Vinyl Bar offers a relaxed, intimate atmosphere suitable for casual dining, date nights, and gathering with friends. They provide dine-in service with both cozy indoor seating and an alfresco courtyard, alongside takeout and delivery options. The establishment is centered around a unique social experience, combining high-quality food and cocktails with a curated vinyl music listening experience.
properties.ambience_description: The space exudes a warm, retro-inspired feel that combines the vibe of a jazz den with the comfort of a private home. With vinyl records playing through high-fidelity sound systems, the atmosphere is cozy, eclectic, and deeply focused on sensory experience.
properties.amenities_description: The establishment offers both air-conditioned indoor seating and an open-air courtyard. It features a curated vinyl music system and a bar service specializing in craft cocktails and small-plate dining.
properties.unique_selling_points: This is India's first bar dedicated to vinyl records, offering a unique sound experience paired with innovative cocktails featuring locally sourced feni. The menu emphasizes artisanal, fermented-food creations served in a deeply personalized and thematic environment.
properties.neighborhood_description: Located in a quiet and historic neighborhood known for its unique cultural character, the surroundings provide a relaxed, authentic atmosphere. Its tucked-away position adds to the sense of discovery for those visiting the area.
properties.physical_setting_description: Tucked away in the historic Fontainhas quarter of Panaji, this establishment features a cozy, rustic indoor bar space and an alfresco courtyard setting. The environment feels intimate and secluded from the bustling tourist areas, offering a charming escape.
properties.customer_demographics_description: The restaurant attracts a mix of locals and tourists visiting Goa, particularly those interested in music, craft cocktails, and high-quality artisanal food. The atmosphere draws a trendy crowd, including audiophiles, food enthusiasts, and young professionals seeking a relaxed, culturally-rich social environment.

entities.name: Goenchin

properties.address: Mandovi Apartments Dr Dada Vaidya Rd, near Big G Shopping Mall, Near Mahalaxmi Temple, Altinho Panaji, Goa 403001 India
properties.description: Homey Asian restaurant offering Chinese, Thai and Goan-influenced dishes in cozy red-and-green decor.
properties.short_description: Homey Asian restaurant offering Chinese, Thai and Goan-influenced dishes in cozy red-and-green decor.
properties.cuisine_description: Goenchin is a homey, long-standing Asian restaurant in Panaji serving a diverse menu of Chinese and Thai dishes with distinct Goan influences. The kitchen is well-regarded for its consistency and authentic flavors, featuring signature items like crab meat soup, various chicken preparations, seafood specialties, and traditional Asian desserts. The establishment offers a full bar including cocktails, wine, and beer. While known for its non-vegetarian options, the menu includes vegetarian choices.
properties.overall_description: A long-standing institution in the heart of Panaji, this restaurant is cherished for its consistent, decades-old recipes and comforting Asian-fusion cuisine. With a cozy, retro atmosphere that feels like a trip back in time, it remains a favorite gathering spot for locals celebrating special milestones or seeking familiar, quality flavors. While its popularity sometimes makes parking challenging in the narrow residential streets, the attentive staff and memorable dishes like their signature crab meat soup and unique appetizers ensure it remains a culinary landmark.
properties.service_description: The restaurant provides a full-service dining experience featuring indoor and outdoor seating, takeout, and delivery options. It is a popular destination for celebratory events, including birthdays and anniversaries, and is suitable for family meals or casual dining, with staff known for being friendly and helpful.
properties.ambience_description: The atmosphere is defined by a cozy, homey feel featuring dim lighting and a distinctively retro, nostalgic decor that has been a trademark for decades.
properties.amenities_description: The restaurant provides a full range of beverage services including cocktails and beer alongside comfortable indoor seating and limited outdoor space.
properties.unique_selling_points: This establishment is celebrated for its remarkable consistency and longevity, having served iconic Asian-fusion flavors for over four decades. It is widely regarded as a classic culinary institution in the city.
properties.neighborhood_description: The neighborhood is a central, historic part of the city characterized by a blend of residential charm and local landmarks, offering an authentic urban atmosphere.
properties.physical_setting_description: Situated in the heart of Panaji near a prominent temple, the restaurant is tucked away on a narrow, primarily residential street. Its location offers an urban feel within a historic part of the city.
properties.customer_demographics_description: The restaurant attracts a loyal, local customer base, including families and groups of friends who have frequented the establishment for decades. It is a favored spot for residents celebrating special life events and for those seeking a consistent, long-established dining experience in Panaji.
